extensionDescription.message: Lisez l'anglais et l'espagnol sur le web : mots inconnus surlignés, pourcentage honnête. Hors ligne et privé.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description: the extensions page, and both stores' summary. At most 112 characters (Apple's limit). Names the languages a French reader can study in the shipped pairs. Held equal to manifest.json's literal by yarn check:version.

commandCaptureSelection.message: Capturer la sélection (mot ou expression) avec sa phrase
commandCaptureSelection.description: The Alt+L command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: capture the selected word or phrase together with its sentence.

commandToggleDrawer.message: Ouvrir/fermer le panneau de révision sur la page
commandToggleDrawer.description: The Alt+Shift+D command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: open or close the in-page review panel (the drawer).

commandSidePanel.message: Ouvrir le panneau latéral de révision
commandSidePanel.description: The Alt+Shift+S command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: open the browser's review side panel (Chromium).
